summary: R1, R2 and R3 landed together: _RELEASE_KEYS gained the five Argo keys, resolve() stops at the top-level allowlist for a non-jenkins entry (no chart-existence trip, no _UPSTREAM_KEYS check, and upstream dropped from the record so all three entry shapes report a falsy chart), discover_releases skips such a stage by direct file read, and eight writing verbs refuse it while plan/output/config/wait still work. kc project test is green at 49 tests, mutation-checked; a real-tree smoke entry made `deploy config` exit 0 with chart_name: null and left discover_releases returning exactly the 51 jenkins-owned stages.
